welcome_page.title: Car – When the car is hard to replace
welcome_page.description:
Some trips are hard to make without a car. Tell us which ones you use the car for. Most questions are answered Yes or No.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name. Giving your email is optional; the SmartUrbanity privacy notice explains how it is protected and how answers are used.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: What do you use the car for? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Taking older relatives or people with walking difficulties out
Going with someone to medical or official appointments
Travelling at night or getting to night shifts, when public transport is scarce
Reaching places with no direct public transport, for example work outside the ring road
Carrying heavy work tools or equipment
Getting around when public transport is on strike
Getting around because my area is poorly served by public transport
Doing several errands in different places on the same day
Travelling with small children and their things (pushchair, bags)
Making sure someone does not have to come home alone by public transport at night
Carrying animals, for example to the vet
Doing big grocery shopping
Carrying bulky or fragile items
Picking people up with luggage at a station or airport, especially in the evening
Taking bulky or hazardous waste to a collection point
Being sure of getting back, even after many hours
Making unexpected trips, even out of town
Getting around when shared cars or taxis are hard to find (e.g. at night or in outer areas)
None of these

questions.text: If there were a reliable alternative for these trips, would you use the car less?

options.text: Yes
No
